steps.operation: Load p_brand and p_container dictionaries, resolve parameter codes
steps.details: Dict format: uint32_t count, then [uint16_t len, char[len]] per entry. Find int8_t code for brand and container parameters.

steps.operation: Scan part columns, collect qualifying partkeys
steps.details: Scan p_brand and p_container (both int8_t). Collect p_partkey values where both match. Store qualifying partkeys in a flat vector.

Create hash map: partkey → compact_id (0..~2K). This enables compact accumulator arrays that fit in L1 cache. Also create a bitset over partkey domain (2M bits = 250KB) for fast membership testing during lineitem scans.

steps.operation: Parallel scan lineitem to compute per-part AVG(l_quantity)
steps.details: For each lineitem row, test l_partkey membership via bitset. If qualifying, look up compact_id from hash map. Accumulate thread-local sum_qty[compact_id] and count[compact_id]. Merge thread-local arrays after scan (arrays are ~2K entries = 32KB, trivial merge).
For each compact_id: threshold[compact_id] = 0.2 * (sum_qty[compact_id] / count[compact_id]). Array of ~2K doubles = 16KB, fits L1.

steps.operation: Parallel scan lineitem to sum qualifying l_extendedprice
steps.details: For each lineitem row, test l_partkey membership via bitset. If qualifying, look up compact_id, check l_quantity < threshold[compact_id]. If passes, add l_extendedprice to thread-local accumulator. Final reduction across threads.

join_order.notes: Bitset over 2M partkey domain (250KB) for fast membership test; compact hash map for index lookup. Two-pass: pass1 aggregates qty, pass2 filters and sums price.

data_structures.partkey_membership: bitset(2000000) — 250KB for fast membership test during lineitem scan
data_structures.partkey_to_compact: compact_hash_map<int32_t, uint16_t>(pre_sized ~2K) — partkey to compact index
data_structures.thresholds: double[~2K] — 0.2 * avg_qty per compact_id, 16KB fits L1
data_structures.pass2_accumulator: thread_local double — running sum of l_extendedprice

parallelism.pass1: Parallel scan l_partkey + l_quantity with thread-local compact arrays (~32KB each). Merge via simple array addition.
parallelism.pass2: Parallel scan l_partkey + l_quantity + l_extendedprice with thread-local scalar accumulator. Final scalar reduction.

mmap_strategy.notes: Declare mmap resources before RAII timer scope to exclude munmap TLB shootdown cost

compiler_hints.vectorization: Use __restrict__ on column pointers to enable auto-vectorization of scan loops
